verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a public web service, and any such site could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only human-facing filing guidance and a robots.txt probe of the e-filing host. Nothing shows an llms.txt file or documentation written for agents.
